tei:div.tei:p: nged zhib 'jug khang nas 'tshol bsdu ma thub pa'i stag lo'i gsung rnams kyi mtshan tho/

rgya ston rin po che'i gsol 'debs/ bcom ldan chen po'i gsol 'debs| phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gsol 'debs/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi gsol 'debs/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i gsol 'debs/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs/ rin chen mchog grub kyi gsol 'debs/ rin chen bsod nams 'phel gyi gsol 'debs/ 'ug tshang rin po che'i gsol 'debs/ 'khon sa skya pa'i gdungs rab rgyas pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i bstod pa/ bu ston rin po che'i bstod pa/ red mda' ba'i bstod pa/ dbus gtsang gi bla ma che chung mang po'i bstod pa/ cho 'phrul bstan tshul la bstod pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi zhing bkod rtogs brjod/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bstod pa/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med la bstod pa| byams pa'i bstod pa/ mtha' gnyis mun sel sogs/ sdeb sbyor pad dkar sogs dang*/ 'od zer can sogs la mang po yod pa thor bur bsdus pa brgya rtsa tsam yod rgyu yin na'ang 'dus pa nyi shu skor/ /mdo rtsa'i ṭīka chen/ sum brgya pa dang lnga cu pa'i ṭīkka/ nyis brgya lnga cu rtsa gsum gyi yan lag rtsis tshigs bcad ma/ mdo rtsa'i ṭīkka spyi bstan ma la spyi don kyang rgyas pa 'khod pa/ sum brgya pa'i ṭīkka bshad pa'i legs pa brgyan/ pha yi so thar gyi ṭīkka/ so thar gzhung lam ste de'i bslab bya/ 'grel ba 'od dang bcas pa/ lung rnam 'byed sogs kyi 'grel ba/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len/ tsaṇḍa pa'i ṭīka chung*/ byings sgrub nyer mkho/ sgra yi spyi don| ka lā pa'i spyi don/ rnam 'grel ṭīka chen dang*/ tshad ma mdo'i 'grel ba lha dbang blo'i 'grel bshad dang bstod pa'i ṭīkka/ rnam 'grel ṭīkka/ rigs thig ṭīkka| gtan tshigs thig pa'i ṭīkka/ 'grel ba brtag pa'i ṭīkka/ rgyud gzhan grub pa'i ṭīkka/ rtsod rig ṭīkka/ sa paṇa gyi rigs gter 'grel ba/ mdo sdud pa'i ṭīkka| phar phyin ṭīkka/ rin chen phreng ba'i ṭīkka/

mdzod kyi zin bris tshigs bcad du byas pa/ mdzod kyi ṭīka chen/ kun btus kyi ṭīkka/ mdo sde rgyan gyi ṭīkka/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi ṭīkka/ mngon pa kun rgyan gyi ṭīkka/ rgyud bla ma rnams kyi ṭīkka/ ltung bshags ṭīkka/ bzang spyod ṭīkka/ byams smon bcu la sogs pa'i 'grel bshad| spyod 'jug ṭīkka/ rtsa shes ṭīkka/ rig pa drug cu pa'i ṭīkka/ stong nyid bdun cu pa'i ṭīkka/ zhib mo rnam 'thag gi ṭīkka/ rtsod bzlog gi ṭīkka 'jug pa'i ṭīkka| bzhi brgya pa'i ṭīkka/ bshes springs kyi ṭīkka/ slob springs kyi ṭīkka/ rtog ge' ི tho ba rnams kyi ṭīkka bslab btus kyi ṭīkka/ mdo kun las btus kyi ṭīkka/ rtog ge 'bar ba'i ṭīkka/ ye shes snying po'i bden gnyis kyi ṭīkka/ sor thar gyi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag lag len dang bcas pa/ byang sems kyi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag lag len dang bcas pa/ rigs 'dzin gyi sdom pa'i rnam bzhag lag len dang bcas pa| rab dbye'i ṭīkka/ bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi gzungs gra lnga'i mngon dkyil| 'od zer can ma'i mngon dkyil/ gdugs dkar rnam rgyal gyi mngon dkyil| padma'i rigs la bcu gcig zhal lha so bdun ma klu sgrub lugs kyi mngon dkyil| spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang gi mngon dkyil/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 'dus pa'i smon lam/ stobs po che rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nyams len dang sbyar ba/ 'gro bzang ma rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nyams len dang sbyar ba/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi 'jam rdor mngon dkyil mchod phreng*| de 'jig rten dbang phyug mi bskyod pa lha bcu dgu ma/ dam tshig rdo rje/ bgegs mthar byed rnams la 'don pa spo tshul/ 'jam rdor mchod 'phreng gi smon lam| rdzogs rim gyi khrid yig zur pa/ rnal 'byor rdzogs 'phreng gi gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs dang snying po lha grangs dang bcas pa/

'khor chen mngon rtogs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon dkyil/ mchod phreng*/ dgra nag gi mngon rtogs/ gdong drug gi mngon rtogs/ gshed dmar lha lnga dang bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs/ drug cu pa'i gtor chog rgyas pa/ dril bu ba'i dkyil chog rim lnga smon lam dang bcas pa/ nag po pa'i mngon dkyil/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs/ sgyu thod gnas gsum gyi mngon rtogs/ grub rgyal ma'i tshe khrid dang mngon rtogs/ grub rgyal ma'i dkyil chog gnyis med la/ kyai rdor gyi mngon rtogs/ kyai rdor dkyil chog mchod 'phreng*/ gur rigs bsdus kyi mngon rtogs/ gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs/ chos rje bu ston gyi mngon rtogs lhan thabs/ mchod 'phreng/ sdom chen dang*/ dpal ldan rgyud kyi mngon rtogs| sems 'grel lugs kyi bde skyes kyi mngon rtogs/ sems 'grel lugs kyi bde skyes kyi dkyil chog thig gi bshad pa/ phyag rgya'i rim pa/ rab gnas cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho/ sbyin sreg cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho/ tshogs 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi rgya mtsho/ lho sgo'i cho ga ngan 'gro kun 'joms/ rtsis kyi lag len| lnga bsdus gza' lnga cha gnyis/ nyi zla gza' 'jin/ dus sbyor g.yul rgyal la brten pa'i lag len rgyas pa/ 'grel chen la brten pa'i yul drug gi dus sbyor/ nyi ma'i go la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud la brten pa'i rtsis 'bras/ skyon spong rgyal ba dgyes byed/ rtsod zlog rtsis 'bras 'dod dgu kun 'byung*/ bstan rtsis/ rtsa chad kyi ltas brtag nas 'chi ba bslu ba sogs dang*/ bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag 'dres 'khrug rnam 'byed/ rtsa chad 'chi ltas kyi bshad pa man ngag la/ kun gyi shes byed la 'grel chen gyi sa bcad/ sngon 'gro rgyud la 'jug pa'i dga' ston/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa/ gsang 'dus bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/

bde mchog bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ kyaie rdor bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ gshin rje gshed skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs| rdor phreng bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bka' gdams glegs bam gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rang rang gi nyams len smon lam du bsdus pa rnams dang*/ rang bskul mi 'gyod bco brgyad kyi gsung mgur/ gzhan bskul| dris len sogs phran tshegs shin tu mang po/ legs ldan gyi bstod pa/ tshogs bdag gi bstod pa/ rnam sras kyi bstod pa/ las gshin gyi bstod pa/ bskang bshags chen mo dang bcas pa/ smon lam lam rim du dril ba/ bkra shis thun mong ba dang bcas dang*/ mdo sde kun shes rtsa ba/ mdo sde kun shes 'grel ba/ rgyud sde kun shes rtsa ba/ rgyud sde kun shes 'grel ba/ rtsa ltung rnam bshad/ dus 'khor thig rtsa/ dus 'khor nyams len bsdus pa'i lag len/ dus 'khor dkyil chog cha lag dang bcas pa/ dus 'khor kyi dbang gi spyi don/ bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi sku gsum lam 'khyer dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs/ gnyis med lugs kyi rim gnyis| phyag rdor bstod 'grel la brten pa'i lha re gnyis ma/ dus 'khor lugs kyi gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs/ sdom pa che ba'i sgrub thabs/ dus 'khor rdzogs rim ngo sprod/ dus 'khor mtha' dpyod/ sngags rim/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid yig zur pa/ nag rtsis kyi rnam gzhag sman dpyad lag len gces bsdus/ gso dpyad byung tshul rnam thar rgyas pa| gso rig spyi yi rnam gzhag lag len gces bsdus/ gso rig gi byung ba gsong por brjod pa drang srong srid sgrub kyi mda' zhes pa/ rgya gar rgya nag bod sogs la gso dpyad spyir 'byung tshul/ mkhas mchog dpa' bo'i rnam thar rgyas pa/ 'phags pa lha'i rnam thar/ de nas lo chen la rin gyi brgyud tshul/ bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi dbye bsdu/

sman dpyad spyi yi rnam gzhag rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i gzhung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog lag len gcig bsdus reg pa'i nad sel zhes pa le'u bcu pa kun la mkho ba/ chos rje lo chen gyi rnam thar/ sdom 'byung gi 'grel ba la brten pa'i sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad bshad pa/ rtsis kyi rnam gzhag mdzangs blun mdo don smon lam dang sbyar ba/ bsngo ba'i mdo don smon lam du bsdus pa/ de'i don bsdus smon lam tshigs bcad rnam gzhag gi bshad pa rgya cher bshad pa/ sdom 'byung gi 'brel ba/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi lha la mdor bsdus te phyag 'tshal ba'i rab tu byed pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo smon lam bkra shis ya mtshan can/ kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thab 'bring po/ dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad snying po don gsal/ gshin rje gshed kyi gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i cho ga lag len byed tshul/ 'di na lha yin mchod sbyin dpal/ /tshe dang bsod nams thams cad khab len gyi rdo lcags kyi gser yang bsdus pa ji bzhin du 'chi med rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i yid 'phrog bka' gdams glegs bam gyi thig le bcu drug gi dbang chog kha skong*/ smon lam legs tshogs kun 'byung zhes bya ba lam rim gsal byed/ bsngo ba'i bshad pa/ dus kyi rnam gzhag skyon bral yon tan gyi dus kun legs 'byed mkhas pa dga' byed/ lnga bsdus gdong rtsis legs 'pho dang*/ gza' lnga'i nyi zla gza' 'dzin dang*/ dus sbyor mkhas pa dga' byed pa/ rtsis 'bras blang dor bya tshul/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'beb/ chos 'khor ba rje yab sras gsum gyi gsol 'debs rnam thar ma re la 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ chos rje lo chen gyi rnam thar bcas skabs 'dir dpe bskrun ma thob pa'i chos tshan nyis brgya nyi shu po 'di yang 'tshol bsdu dang myur skyobs bya rogs zhes gus 'dud dang bcas thub bstan nyi mas dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas zla tshes dge ba'i nyin phul/
